visualCharacteristics: A full-bleed band with a background visual (video poster) overlaid by a large title, a sub title and a light CTA button.
contentPattern: A media row with the background picture, then a text row with an h2 title, an h3 sub title and a CTA paragraph (em strong link = light button).
usage: Use for a full-width promotional band (such as the Priority loyalty programme) with a background image, short headline and one call to action.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any mid-page image band with a headline and single CTA; use the page hero for top-of-page introductions.
